fragments.html:
SkyArc
SkyArcSection, ArcRenderer · Spot/SkyArcView.swift
Where the sun and moon are, by compass direction and height, at the shared marker time.
Arc does not zoom
Zooming narrows the timeline and hourly strip only; the sky arc keeps the whole day.
